## Directory summary
All-in payoff assets for the `rebel_296_4000` WebGPU export fixture.

### Source files
- `allin_manifest.json`: Manifest fragment embedded into the WebGPU model export.
- `preflop.i16`: Quantized preflop all-in payoff table, indexed by hero combo then opponent combo.
- `preflop_allin_table.pt.zst`: PyTorch preflop all-in payoff table used by Python CFR parity tests.

### Subdirectories
There are no child source directories.
